title: Implement auth middleware refactor
body:
## Background

The current auth middleware has grown organically and now contains both authentication and authorization logic in a monolithic file. This makes it difficult to test individual concerns and extend with new auth methods.

## What

- Separate concerns: AuthHandler, TokenValidator, PermissionChecker
- Add support for JWT tokens with rotation
- Implement cache layer for permission checks
- Update all integration tests

## Close Criteria

- All tests pass with 100% coverage of new modules
- Existing auth behavior is preserved
- No performance regression
close_criteria: All tests pass with 100% coverage of new modules; existing auth behavior is preserved; no performance regression
